name: Convex Object Optimization
aliases: Convex Shape Optimization for Internal Origins
Inverse ray tracing for convex objects
definition: An optimization for sphere tracing convex objects represented by a signed distance bound enclosed by a convex bounding volume. It avoids costly marching through the interior of the object by using inverse ray tracing from the bounding volume intersection.
summary: Convex Object Optimization accelerates sphere tracing by using a convex bounding volume to determine entry and exit points, avoiding costly interior traversal.
